page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.32xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual instance built on the x86_64 architecture. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor operating at 2.7 GHz, the instance delivers 128 dedicated vCPUs alongside 256.0 GB of system memory. This configuration establishes a memory-to-vCPU ratio of 2.0 GB per core. The instance runs on a KVM hypervisor and incorporates a 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth interface. It does not include integrated GPU accelerators.

The ecs.c7.32xlarge instance contains no local ephemeral storage, requiring all persistent data to be hosted on external block storage volumes. The 64 Gbps baseline network bandwidth mitigates potential network bottlenecks when communicating with remote block storage or distributed nodes. The hardware configuration emphasizes vCPU capacity over memory capacity, providing core density for multi-threaded processing without allocating excess RAM capacity.

Given the 128 vCPUs and high network bandwidth, the ecs.c7.32xlarge instance is structured for compute-bound, parallel execution tasks. Appropriate workloads include batch processing operations, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD) pipelines, ETL data processing, compute-intensive web serving, and distributed simulation tasks.
